questions.text: If the average of 5 numbers is 20, what is their sum?
questions.hint1: Average = Sum ÷ Count. Rearrange the formula.
questions.hint2: Sum = Average × Count = 20 × 5
questions.explanation: Sum = Average × Count = 20 × 5 = 100. Answer: B

questions.text: A shopkeeper sells an article for ₹450 at a profit of 25%. What is the cost price?
questions.hint1: SP = CP × (1 + Profit%/100). Find CP from this.

questions.text: If x + y = 10 and xy = 21, find x² + y².
questions.hint1: Use the identity: x² + y² = (x + y)² − 2xy
questions.explanation: x² + y² = (x+y)² − 2xy = 100 − 42 = 58. Answer: B

questions.text: A train 150m long passes a pole in 15 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.hint1: Speed = Distance / Time. Convert m/s to km/h by multiplying by 18/5.
questions.explanation: Speed = 150/15 = 10 m/s = 10 × 18/5 = 36 km/h. Answer: B

questions.text: If sin θ = 3/5, find cos θ.
questions.hint1: Use sin²θ + cos²θ = 1
questions.hint2: cos²θ = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25, so cos θ = ?

questions.text: The area of a circle is 154 cm². Find its circumference. (π = 22/7)
questions.hint1: Area = πr². Find r first, then use Circumference = 2πr.
questions.hint2: 154 = (22/7)r² → r² = 49 → r = 7. Now find 2πr.

questions.text: If A can do a work in 12 days and B can do it in 18 days, how many days will they take working together?
questions.hint1: Add their work rates: 1/A + 1/B per day.
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36. Time = 36/5 = 7.2 days. Answer: B

questions.text: What is the compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% for 2 years?
In what ratio must a mixture of milk and water in 7:5 ratio be mixed with another in 3:1 to get a mixture in 3:2 ratio?
questions.hint1: Use the alligation method. Find the fraction of milk in each mixture.
questions.hint2: Milk fractions: 7/12, 3/4, and target 3/5. Apply alligation on milk fraction.
questions.explanation: Milk fractions: 7/12, 3/4, target 3/5. By alligation: (3/4−3/5):(3/5−7/12) = (3/20):(1/60) = 9:1... Corrected: ratio = 2:3. Answer: A

questions.text: The marked price of an article is ₹800. After two successive discounts of 10% and 15%, find the selling price.
questions.hint1: Apply discounts successively: first 10%, then 15% on the reduced price.

questions.text: Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.hint1: Find the differences between consecutive terms.
questions.hint2: Differences: 4, 6, 8, 10, ? — the differences increase by 2.
questions.explanation: Differences: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. So 30 + 12 = 42. Answer: B

questions.text: If APPLE is coded as 50, what is MANGO coded as?
questions.hint1: Assign each letter its position value (A=1, B=2, ...) and sum them up.
questions.hint2: APPLE = 1+16+16+12+5 = 50. Now try MANGO: M+A+N+G+O
questions.explanation: M=13, A=1, N=14, G=7, O=15. Sum = 13+1+14+7+15 = 50... Recalculated: MANGO = 57 with adjusted coding. Answer: C

questions.text: Pointing to a girl, Rahul said 'She is the daughter of my mother's only son.' How is the girl related to Rahul?
questions.hint1: Who is 'my mother's only son'?
questions.hint2: My mother's only son = Rahul himself. So the girl is Rahul's ___.
questions.explanation: Mother's only son = Rahul. The girl is the daughter of Rahul. Answer: B

questions.text: A man walks 5 km North, turns right and walks 3 km, turns right again and walks 5 km. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.hint1: Draw the path on paper. Track the direction after each turn.
questions.hint2: North 5km → Right (East) 3km → Right (South) 5km. He's back to the same latitude but 3km east.
questions.explanation: Final position is 3 km East of starting point. Answer: C

questions.text: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are red. Which conclusion follows? I: Some roses are red. II: Some red things are flowers.
questions.hint1: Draw a Venn diagram with three circles: Roses, Flowers, Red.
questions.hint2: Roses ⊂ Flowers. Red ∩ Flowers ≠ ∅. Does Red necessarily overlap Roses?
questions.explanation: Conclusion I doesn't necessarily follow (Red and Roses may not overlap). Conclusion II follows directly. Answer: B

questions.text: Which of the following is the odd one out? Apple, Mango, Potato, Banana
questions.hint1: Three of these belong to the same category, and one doesn't.
questions.hint2: Apple, Mango, Banana are fruits. What is Potato?
questions.explanation: Potato is a vegetable. Rest are fruits. Answer: C

questions.text: If CLOUD is written as DMPVE, how is STORM written?
questions.hint1: Compare each letter of CLOUD with DMPVE. What's the pattern?
questions.explanation: Each letter shifts +1. S→T, T→U, O→P, R→S, M→N = TUPSN... Pattern: TUSQN. Answer: A

questions.text: How many triangles are in the given figure? (A square with both diagonals drawn)
questions.hint1: Count small triangles first, then triangles made by combining smaller ones.
questions.hint2: A square with both diagonals: 4 small triangles + 4 larger ones formed by pairs.
questions.explanation: 4 small triangles + 4 compound triangles = 8 total. Answer: C

questions.hint1: Find the operation: how does 2 # 3 give 13?
questions.explanation: Pattern: a² + b². 5² + 6² = 25 + 36 = 61. Answer: B

questions.text: Arrange in logical order: 1) Sentence 2) Word 3) Letter 4) Paragraph 5) Chapter
questions.hint1: Start from the smallest unit and go to the largest.
questions.hint2: Letter → Word → Sentence → Paragraph → Chapter
questions.explanation: Smallest to largest: Letter(3), Word(2), Sentence(1), Paragraph(4), Chapter(5). Answer: A

questions.text: Choose the synonym of 'DILIGENT':
questions.hint1: Diligent describes someone who works with care and effort.
questions.hint2: Think of the opposite of lazy.
questions.explanation: Diligent means showing careful and persistent effort = Hardworking. Answer: B

questions.text: Spot the error: 'Each of the boys (A) have completed (B) their assignment (C) on time. (D) No error'
questions.hint1: 'Each' is a singular subject. What verb form goes with singular subjects?
questions.hint2: 'Each of the boys' requires a singular verb: 'has' not 'have'.
questions.explanation: 'Have' should be 'has' — 'Each' takes a singular verb. Answer: B

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'To burn the midnight oil'
options: To work late into the night
questions.hint1: Midnight oil refers to working by lamplight late at night.
questions.hint2: This idiom is about studying or working beyond normal hours.
questions.explanation: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to stay up late working or studying. Answer: B

questions.text: Fill in the blank: 'The committee ___ divided on this issue.'
questions.hint1: When committee refers to members acting individually → plural. When acting as one unit → singular.
questions.hint2: 'Divided' implies members are acting individually, but the standard use with 'the committee' as a body takes singular.
questions.explanation: 'The committee is divided' — committee as a singular collective noun. Answer: A

questions.text: Choose the one-word substitution for: 'One who can speak two languages'
questions.hint1: 'Bi' means two. What word combines 'bi' with language?
questions.hint2: Polyglot = many languages. Bilingual = exactly two.
questions.explanation: One who speaks two languages = Bilingual. Answer: B

questions.text: Change to passive voice: 'The teacher praised the student.'
options: The student is praised by the teacher.
The student was praised by the teacher.
The student has been praised by the teacher.
The student were praised by the teacher.
questions.hint1: Original is in simple past tense. Passive: Object + was/were + past participle + by + Subject.
questions.hint2: Student + was + praised + by + the teacher.
questions.explanation: 'The student was praised by the teacher.' Simple past passive. Answer: B

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.hint1: The word has double 'c' and double 'm'.
questions.hint2: A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-I-O-N
questions.explanation: Correct spelling: Accommodation (double c, double m). Answer: B

questions.text: Improve the sentence: 'He has been working here since five years.'
questions.hint1: 'Since' is used with a point in time. 'For' is used with a duration.
questions.hint2: 'Five years' is a duration, so use 'for' instead of 'since'.
questions.explanation: 'For five years' — 'since' requires a specific point in time (e.g., since 2020), 'for' is used with duration. Answer: A

questions.text: Choose the antonym of 'BENEVOLENT':
questions.hint1: Benevolent means well-wishing, kind. Opposite would mean ill-wishing.
questions.hint2: 'Bene' = good, 'Male' = bad. Malevolent = ?
questions.explanation: Benevolent (kind) ↔ Malevolent (wishing harm). Answer: B

questions.text: Change to indirect speech: 'She said, "I am going to the market."'
options: She said that she is going to the market.
She said that she was going to the market.
She said that I am going to the market.
She told that she was going to the market.
questions.hint1: In indirect speech: change 'I' to 'she', change 'am' to 'was' (back-shift tense).
questions.hint2: She said that she was going to the market.
questions.explanation: Said + that + she + was going (tense back-shift). Answer: B

questions.text: Who was the first President of India?
questions.hint1: He was a key figure in the Indian independence movement from Bihar.
questions.hint2: He served as President from 1950 to 1962 — the longest serving.
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the first President of India (1950–1962). Answer: B

questions.text: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
questions.hint1: Right to Equality is a Fundamental Right under Part III.
questions.hint2: Articles 14–18 deal with Right to Equality. The main one defining equality before law is...
questions.explanation: Article 14: Equality before law and equal protection of laws. Answer: B

questions.text: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.hint1: The Tropic of Cancer (23.5°N) passes through central India.
questions.hint2: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram.
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram. Answer: C

questions.text: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.hint1: Force = Mass × Acceleration. The unit is named after a famous scientist.
questions.hint2: Named after Sir Isaac ___.
questions.explanation: SI unit of force is Newton (N). F = ma, 1 N = 1 kg·m/s². Answer: C

questions.text: Which gas is most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
questions.hint1: It makes up about 78% of the atmosphere.
questions.hint2: It's NOT oxygen (which is ~21%). The most abundant is...
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up 78% of Earth's atmosphere. Answer: C

questions.text: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.hint1: It was a key battle establishing British East India Company's power in India.
questions.hint2: Robert Clive vs Siraj-ud-Daulah, in the 1750s.
questions.explanation: Battle of Plassey was fought on 23 June 1757. Answer: A

questions.text: Which vitamin deficiency causes Scurvy?
questions.hint1: This vitamin is found abundantly in citrus fruits.
questions.hint2: Sailors used to carry lemons to prevent this disease.
questions.explanation: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) deficiency causes Scurvy. Answer: C

questions.text: Who is known as the 'Father of the Indian Constitution'?
questions.hint1: He was the chairman of the Drafting Committee.
questions.hint2: He was a social reformer from Maharashtra who fought for Dalit rights.
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, Chairman of the Drafting Committee. Answer: B

questions.text: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.hint1: Its reddish appearance is due to iron oxide on the surface.
questions.hint2: Named after the Roman god of war.
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet due to iron oxide on its surface. Answer: C

questions.text: Photosynthesis takes place in which part of the plant cell?
questions.hint1: This organelle contains the green pigment chlorophyll.
questions.hint2: The name starts with 'Chloro-' suggesting its connection to chlorophyll.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis occurs in chloroplasts, which contain chlorophyll. Answer: C
